# Tezca

> Tezca (tezca.mx) is an open Mexican law platform: federal, state and municipal legislation in digital form, taken from official sources (Diario Oficial de la Federación, Orden Jurídico Nacional and the state official gazettes), with full-text search, cross-references between laws and side-by-side comparison. The site is in Spanish, with English and Náhuatl interface options. Reading and searching the law is free; paid plans add larger result pages, more export formats, API keys and webhooks.

## Explore the law

- [Laws](https://tezca.mx/leyes): browse the catalogue of laws
- [Search](https://tezca.mx/busqueda): full-text search across articles
- [States](https://tezca.mx/estados): state legislation for the 32 Mexican states
- [Categories](https://tezca.mx/categorias): laws grouped by area of law
- [Compare](https://tezca.mx/comparar): compare laws side by side

## Plans and developers

- [Pricing](https://tezca.mx/precios): free account and paid plans (current prices are on this page)
- [Developers](https://tezca.mx/desarrolladores): REST API documentation (base URL https://api.tezca.mx/api/v1)
